transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile emergency customer support. My name is Warren. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Warren. I need urgent help right away. My iPhone 15 Pro was stolen out of my jacket pocket about forty-five minutes ago while I was travelling on the commuter train from London Waterloo to Guildford! I need my SIM card barred and the handset completely blacklisted so the thief cannot access my data or make international calls!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly execute an immediate emergency SIM bar and IMEI blacklist for you, Kyle. Before we access your cellular subscriber profile, may I please verify your billing address and your security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 19 Millmead Terrace, Guildford, GU2 4AT. And my security question answer is my mother's maiden name, Fletcher.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Kyle, that verifies the mobile subscriber account. What is the stolen mobile telephone number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The phone number is 07700 900741. Warren, I was actually cornered and jostled by a gang of three youths near the carriage doors, and they snatched it right as the train pulled into Woking station! My banking apps, work email, and personal family photos are all on that phone! I am physically shaking with panic and anxiety right now because I don't know if they can break into my bank accounts!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how terrifying and traumatic that mugging experience was for you on the train, Kyle. Being targeted by a group of thieves and worrying about your financial accounts and personal data is deeply distressing, so let us lock down that SIM card immediately to ensure nobody can access your services.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Warren, I really appreciate your understanding. Please bar the SIM right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am opening the Home Location Register gateway console to issue an immediate network suspension command.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Has the SIM card been blocked from making calls and data connections?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The HLR switch has successfully applied a full outgoing and incoming administrative call and SMS bar on mobile number 07700 900741.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What happens if the thief tries to put the SIM card into another phone?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The network gateway rejects the IMSI chip registration on all UK and international mobile networks; zero calls, texts, or mobile data can transmit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That stops any two-factor authentication SMS codes from reaching them, which protects my bank accounts.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Two-factor SMS interception is completely blocked.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Now what about the actual physical iPhone 15 Pro? Can you blacklist the IMEI number so the hardware cannot be used by anyone?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can query your equipment records to pull the manufacturer IMEI identity number from your network registration history.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does your system have the exact fifteen-digit IMEI logged?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The last device attached to the cell tower radio network carries IMEI 3548 9109 2841 029.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that matches the IMEI on the original Apple invoice in my email.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you left an expensive iPhone sitting in an open pocket while distracted on a crowded train, you only have your own carelessness to blame for opportunistic theft.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I was physically assaulted and mugged by three aggressive youths at the carriage doors! How dare you call that carelessness! That is completely unprofessional and deeply offensive!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am initiating the Central Equipment Identity Register blacklist submission.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You still haven't apologized for that disgraceful accusation!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The IMEI blacklist entry has populated across the national GSMA database, barring the device across all UK and European mobile carriers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What happens when the thief tries to turn the phone on or insert another network's SIM card?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The baseband modem registers 'No Service' across EE, Vodafone, Three, and O2; the device cannot connect to any cellular mast.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So the handset is basically an expensive brick to them now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously that confirms the stolen physical handset is completely disabled from commercial resale or cellular communication, Kyle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me a great sense of satisfaction that they cannot profit from stealing my phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Do you need a Crime Reference Number logged against this account for an insurance claim?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, British Transport Police gave me Crime Reference Number BTP-4491-08.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have appended police incident reference BTP-4491-08 to your permanent account audit file.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you email me an official 'Proof of Blacklisting' document to forward to my insurance company?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can generate an official S-Net Certificate of Barring and IMEI Blacklisting PDF letter.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please email that certificate to my registered email address right away.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The barring certificate has been dispatched to your email address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have received the PDF. That satisfies my insurer's claims criteria completely.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could we also dispatch a replacement electronic eSIM profile by email rather than waiting for physical post?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I install an eSIM on my spare phone right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: For fraud prevention following a reported crime, high-security policy mandates that the primary line must be restored via physical SIM with tracked courier signature.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That makes total sense to prevent identity theft or fraudulent SIM swaps.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A physical 5G Multi-SIM card will be dispatched under DPD tracked priority delivery.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will the replacement SIM keep my existing mobile phone number and all my contract allowances?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, your existing mobile number 07700 900741 and Unlimited 5G Max tariff will be provisioned directly onto the new SIM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When will DPD deliver the replacement SIM?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The SIM card will be delivered tomorrow morning by DPD tracked courier before twelve noon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have an old iPhone 11 at home in a drawer that I can pop the replacement SIM into tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once the SIM arrives, you simply insert it into the spare handset and text 'ACTIVATE' to 2020 or call customer service.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long does activation take once I text ACTIVATE?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Network activation completes within fifteen minutes of sending the SMS code.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will get me back in communication with my workplace and family by tomorrow lunchtime.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check that international roaming is also permanently disabled on your cellular profile to prevent rogue charges.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, please confirm international roaming and premium rate numbers are barred.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have placed a strict spend cap of zero pounds on international outbound calls and roaming traffic.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That protects me from any unexpected telephone charges.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check your iCloud activation lock status using Apple's web portal from your home computer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I logged into icloud.com on my laptop right before calling you and toggled 'Lost Mode' with remote erase pending.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Remote wipe ensures all local encryption keys in the secure enclave will be erased if the device ever touches WiFi.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me total peace of mind that my bank passwords and photos are safe.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to reconfirm, the replacement SIM card is dispatched to 19 Millmead Terrace, Guildford, ticket SUP-91044.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: 19 Millmead Terrace, Guildford. That is completely correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will remain the dedicated owner for this security case and ensure the replacement SIM order ships cleanly from our warehouse.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for getting the SIM barred and the IMEI blacklisted so quickly, Warren.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your mobile service or emergency security bar that I can assist you with today, Kyle?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that has sorted all the emergency security steps. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All security actions complete. Good afternoon and take care. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Warren.
